title: How is a reefer service cancelled, and what does cancellation cost?
content:
## Scope

This clause of **Reefer Cargo Services** governs the cancellation of a reefer service for one container: who can cause it, up to which point it is possible, and what it costs at each stage.

## Rule

1. A reefer service is cancelled on the customer's instruction or together with its booking, and **only before plug-in**.
2. Cancelled **before inspection**, it costs nothing.
3. Cancelled **after inspection**, the inspection fee stays charged, and the tier's cancellation fee after inspection is added **once**, under the cancellation fee charge, when that fee is above 0.00 USD.
4. A plugged-in reefer cannot be cancelled. The booking must be cancelled under the booking rules and the laden container withdrawn from the terminal.

## Cancellation fee after inspection by tier

| Tier | Cancellation fee after inspection |
|---|---|
| AHL Reefer Standard | 0.00 USD (no cancellation fee is added) |
| AHL Reefer Monitored | 0.00 USD (no cancellation fee is added) |
| AHL Reefer Cold Treatment | 150.00 USD |
| AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere | 250.00 USD |
| AHL Reefer Pharma GDP | 200.00 USD |
| AHL Reefer Superfreezer | 300.00 USD |

This fee comes in addition to the inspection fee already charged; it does not replace it.

## Decision table by service status

| Service status | Can the reefer service be cancelled? | Cost consequence |
|---|---|---|
| Requested (not yet inspected) | Yes | Nothing |
| PTI passed (inspected, not plugged in) | Yes | Inspection fee stays charged; the tier's cancellation fee is added once when above 0.00 USD |
| Plugged in | No | The booking must be cancelled under the booking rules and the laden container withdrawn from the terminal |
| In transit, delivered or closed | No | Cancellation is possible only before plug-in |

## Hypothetical cases

> **AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere, PTI passed.** The customer instructs cancellation. The service is cancelled; the inspection fee already charged remains, and a cancellation fee of 250.00 USD is added once.

> **AHL Reefer Monitored, PTI passed.** The service is cancelled; the inspection fee remains, and because the tier's cancellation fee is 0.00 USD, no cancellation fee is added.

> **AHL Reefer Superfreezer, requested, not yet inspected.** The booking is cancelled and the reefer service is cancelled with it, at no cost.

> **AHL Reefer Pharma GDP, plugged in at the load terminal.** The customer asks to cancel the reefer service only. A plugged-in reefer cannot be cancelled.

## Basis Q&A

**Will the inspection fee be refunded if the service is cancelled after inspection?** Under this clause the inspection fee stays charged.

**Is the cancellation fee charged twice if the customer and the booking both trigger cancellation?** No. The cancellation fee is added once.
